name: Rainbow Robotics RBQ-10
summary: A 42 kg Korean quadruped for outdoor patrol, inspection and research, with IP54 protection, 15 kg payload, steps up to 25 cm, 2 h operating time (up to 4 h), route patrol with automatic docking and optional PTZ and thermal cameras.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU sales route for the RBQ-10 found: Rainbow's partner list for Europe names only collaborative-robot dealers (Czech Republic, Switzerland, Türkiye), and the product page points to the maker's own inquiry form.

specs.label: Walking speed
specs.conditions: up to 14 km/h in running mode; the page header says walking 6 km/h
specs.quote: 9 km/h (up to 14 km/h in running mode)

specs.label: Stairs and steps
specs.conditions: spec table; page header says step height 20 cm
specs.quote: Stairs and steps: up to 25 cm

specs.label: Operating time
specs.conditions: up to 4 h; swappable batteries, automatic charging support

specs.label: Ingress protection
specs.quote: IP54 dustproof and waterproof design supports stable walking and sensor use in outdoor environments with rain and dust.

specs.label: Built-in sensors
specs.value: IMU, 2 x RGB + depth, 4 x depth; 3D LiDAR, 4K PTZ and thermal camera optional
specs.quote: Surveillance Sensors (optional) 4K PTZ camera and thermal camera

specs.label: Interfaces
specs.value: APIs from LV0 joint level to LV1 gait and posture control; ROS 2, DDS, simulation
specs.quote: ROS 2, DDS integration, and simulation support make upper-system integration and feature expansion easier.

notes: The page header and spec table differ: walking 6 vs 9 km/h, step height 20 vs 25 cm.
Runs a dynamics-based gait by default and a reinforcement-learning gait for slippery ground or high speed.
Wireless charging station and 3D LiDAR are expansion options.

evidence.task: Maker says it patrols predefined routes and docks for charging by itself, with PTZ and thermal modules for surveillance and inspection

researchEvidence.quote: RBQ-10 is a quadruped robot platform designed for stable mobility and mission execution in unstructured outdoor environments such as rough terrain, slopes, and stairs.
IP54 dustproof and waterproof design supports stable walking and sensor use in outdoor environments with rain and dust.

openQuestions: Whether the RBQ-10 is exported to Europe at all (no European RBQ partner listed).
Real deployments: the maker names defence/security, shipbuilding and education as recommended industries but shows no named site.
